caption: The drawing features a single blue object, specifically a vessel or pot, positioned to the left of the composition. The pot has a rounded, bulbous body with a wide opening and a narrow base, and it displays a subtle swirling or ribbed texture across its surface. The entire pot is rendered in shades of blue, with areas of darker and lighter blue suggesting shadows and highlights, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or beige color with no additional objects or details present. The composition centers the blue pot with ample empty space surrounding it, particularly on the right side.
title: Salt Cellar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
